title_zh: 中华文化故事中卢双语分级读本（第一册）
title_en: Graded Readers of Chinese Culture Stories, Book 1
desc_zh: 依据《国际中文教育中文水平等级标准》初等一级编写，中文与卢旺达语对照。选题取材于神话传说、民间故事、成语、寓言和历史故事，每篇附生词表（拼音、卢旺达语释义、等级）。
desc_en: Chinese–Kinyarwanda bilingual stories graded to the Elementary 1 band of the Chinese Proficiency Grading Standards for International Chinese Language Education. Myths, folk tales, idiom stories, fables and history stories, each with a vocabulary list (pinyin, Kinyarwanda gloss, level).
credit: 卢旺达大学孔子学院编；中国教育部中外语言交流合作中心支持
title_rw: Inkuru z’Umuco w’Abashinwa mu Ndimi Ebyiri – Igitabo cya 1
desc_rw: Inkuru z’Igishinwa n’Ikinyarwanda zateguwe hakurikijwe Icyiciro cy’ibanze 1 cy’ingero z’urwego rw’Igishinwa. Harimo imigani, inkuru za rubanda, imvugo z’ubwenge n’inkuru z’amateka; buri nkuru ifite urutonde rw’amagambo mashya (pinyin, ibisobanuro mu Kinyarwanda n’urwego).

title_zh: 中华文化故事中卢双语分级读本（第七册）
title_en: Graded Readers of Chinese Culture Stories, Book 7
desc_zh: 依据《国际中文教育中文水平等级标准》高等编写，中文与卢旺达语对照。选取水浒传、西游记、三国演义、红楼梦等名著片段及爱情、历史故事。
desc_en: Chinese–Kinyarwanda bilingual stories graded to the Advanced band of the Chinese Proficiency Grading Standards for International Chinese Language Education. Selections from the four classic novels, plus love and history stories.
credit: 卢旺达大学孔子学院编；中国教育部中外语言交流合作中心支持
title_rw: Inkuru z’Umuco w’Abashinwa mu Ndimi Ebyiri – Igitabo cya 7
desc_rw: Inkuru z’Igishinwa n’Ikinyarwanda zateguwe hakurikijwe Icyiciro cyo hejuru cy’ingero z’urwego rw’Igishinwa. Harimo ibice by’ibitabo bine by’ingenzi by’Abashinwa, inkuru z’urukundo n’iz’amateka.

desc_zh: 面向以卢旺达语为母语者的零起点口语自学读物。365个常用句覆盖问候、工作、购物、就餐、交通、租房、银行等场景，配拼音、卢旺达语和英语翻译。
desc_en: A zero-start spoken Chinese self-study book for Kinyarwanda speakers: 365 everyday sentences on greetings, work, shopping, dining, transport, housing and banking, with pinyin, Kinyarwanda and English.
desc_rw: Igitabo cyo kwiga kuvuga Igishinwa uhereye ku busa, cyagenewe abavuga Ikinyarwanda: interuro 365 zikoreshwa buri munsi mu gusuhuza, ku kazi, guhaha, kurya, mu ngendo, gukodesha inzu no muri banki, zifite pinyin, Ikinyarwanda n’Icyongereza.

desc_zh: 面向卢旺达导游和旅游从业者的中文教材，18课覆盖接待、换钱、用餐、购物、拍照、看病等情景，附山地大猩猩追踪、阿卡盖拉国家公园等景点解说词。
desc_en: Chinese for Rwandan tour guides and tourism workers: 18 lessons on hosting, money exchange, dining, shopping, photos and health, plus guide scripts for gorilla trekking, Akagera National Park and more.
credit: 杨海霞、曾广煜 编著
desc_rw: Igishinwa cyagenewe abayobora ba mukerarugendo n’abakora mu bukerarugendo mu Rwanda: amasomo 18 yo kwakira abashyitsi, kuvunjisha, kurya, guhaha, gufata amafoto n’ubuzima, hamwe n’ibisobanuro by’ahantu nyaburanga nk’ingagi n’Akagera.

desc_zh: 为在卢、来卢华人编写的卢旺达语入门教材。包括卢旺达语简介、发音规则和24课情景会话（问候、购物、讨价还价、问路、交通、天气等），附生词表和9个常用表达附录。
desc_en: An introductory Kinyarwanda course for Chinese speakers living in or visiting Rwanda: language overview, pronunciation and 24 situational lessons, with a glossary and nine appendices.
desc_rw: Igitabo cyo kwiga Ikinyarwanda cyagenewe Abashinwa baba cyangwa basura u Rwanda: incamake y’ururimi, imivugire, n’amasomo 24 ashingiye ku buzima bwa buri munsi, hamwe n’urutonde rw’amagambo.

desc_zh: 卢旺达大学孔子学院与卢旺达文化遗产学院合作，在《我学卢旺达语》基础上改编。17课从字母、问候、数字到市场、医院，附词汇表、卢旺达语简介和发音规则。
desc_en: Adapted with the Rwanda Cultural Heritage Academy from its course for foreigners learning Kinyarwanda: 17 lessons from the alphabet, greetings and numbers to the market and hospital, with a glossary and pronunciation guide.
credit: 卢旺达大学孔子学院 & 卢旺达文化遗产学院
desc_rw: Cyateguwe ku bufatanye n’Inteko y’Umuco: amasomo 17 kuva ku nyuguti, gusuhuza n’imibare kugeza ku isoko no ku bitaro, hamwe n’urutonde rw’amagambo n’amabwiriza y’imivugire.

title_zh: 斯瓦希里语-中文-英语教材
desc_zh: 斯瓦希里语、中文、英语三语对照。第一部分为常用语与主题词汇（问候、方向、职业、交通、食宿、健康、旅游等），第二部分为语法，第三部分为东非国家与节日阅读。
desc_en: Kiswahili, Chinese and English side by side: everyday phrases and topic vocabulary, a grammar section, and readings on East African countries and holidays.
desc_rw: Igiswahili, Igishinwa n’Icyongereza biri iruhande rumwe: amagambo akoreshwa buri munsi, ikibonezamvugo n’inyandiko zo gusoma ku bihugu by’Afurika y’Iburasirazuba n’iminsi mikuru.
